this_repository.gpu_policy: portable Mojo first; vendor specialization only when justified
this_repository.legacy_cpp_cuda: removed; do not reintroduce project-owned C++/CUDA in inference-engine
this_repository.python_training: model-training stays Python; managed with pixi, not uv
do_not_fake: nightly-only APIs in stable code without an explicit feature/toolchain note
hardware targets not supported by the installed Mojo version
CUDA C++/HIP source as the default GPU implementation
C++26/XMake/CMake requirements inherited from the old implementation
uv as the Python environment manager

dependency_environment.rule: Use pixi. Do not introduce uv, xmake, CMake, Make, or Meson for project-owned code.

toolchain.accelerator_targeting: Use only --target-accelerator values verified by the installed version/current stable docs.

language_policy.strong_typing: Prefer explicit types for public APIs and performance-critical code.

c.rule: Keep the boundary narrow and explicit.

cpp.default: do not introduce as project implementation language

forbidden_defaults: Do not create project-owned C++/CUDA/HIP/Triton implementations.
Do not introduce XMake/CMake/Make/Meson for Mojo source.
Do not use uv for Python environments.
Do not use legacy fn syntax.
Do not hallucinate Mojo or MAX APIs.
